children: Norway technology firm's Q2 revenue rose 4% yr/yr, adjusted EBIT margin improved
Company saw progress in AI-enabled growth and higher billable utilisation
Previously announced ordinary dividend of NOK 0.20 per share paid in Q2
Itera did not provide specific financial guidance for the current quarter or full year in the press release
OPERATIONAL IMPROVEMENTS - Higher billable utilisation and reduced overhead costs contributed to improved adjusted EBIT margin, per co
AI-ENABLED GROWTH - Co said progress in its AI-enabled growth agenda drove positive momentum in customer areas linked to business-critical modernisation, AI-enabled delivery and managed services
CLOUD & APPLICATION SERVICES - CAS unit delivered 28% gross profit growth in Q2, driven by recurring managed services, automation and AI
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "hold"
The average consensus recommendation for the business support services peer group is "buy."
The stock recently traded at 8 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 10 three months ago
